pageHeaders.homeDescription: A quiet place for the people, dates, and memories worth keeping close.
pageHeaders.peopleDescription: The people you want to remember, with profiles coming in the next phase.
pageHeaders.newPersonDescription: Start with the details you know. You can fill in the softer edges later.
pageHeaders.memoriesDescription: Shared moments will collect here, connected back to the people who were part of them.
pageHeaders.newMemoryDescription: Capture the moment, then connect it to the people who were part of it.
pageHeaders.searchDescription: Find people, notes, memories, dates, interactions, and groups from your private records.
pageHeaders.upcomingDescription: Birthdays, anniversaries, reminders, and other important dates gathered by when they are next due.
pageHeaders.settingsDescription: Account and integration boundaries are here early, without requesting extra Google permissions.
pageHeaders.graphDescription: See how your people connect, using only relationships you have already saved.
pageHeaders.exportImportDescription: Download a portable backup or preview a Keepl JSON file before importing selected records.
pageHeaders.editMemoryDescription: Tune the details while keeping the people connection intact.

memoryForm.peopleHint: Connect this memory to everyone who was part of it.
memoryForm.photosHint: Keepl saves references and metadata, not photo files.
memoryForm.photosPickerUnavailable: The Google Photos picker is not available yet. Add a reference manually for now.
memoryForm.photosPickerError: Could not finish the Google Photos picker flow.
memoryForm.photosExternalIdRequired: Add a Google Photos media ID first.

memoryForm.photoReferenceSaved: Reference saved. Google Photos links may expire.

memoryForm.validationEndDate: End date must be after the start date

searchPage.emptyTitle: What do you want to remember?

searchPage.noMatchesDescription: Try fewer words or switch the result type filter.

settings.languageHint: Choose the language Keepl uses for navigation, forms, dates, and settings. Your saved people, notes, dates, and memories stay exactly as they are.
settings.languageSaveError: Could not save language. Keepl will keep using it on this device.
settings.googleConnectedDetail: Sign-in is connected. Contacts, Photos, and Calendar permissions remain separate.
settings.googleUnavailableDetail: No Google provider is attached to the current account.
settings.contactsPermissionDetail: Keepl has a service boundary ready, but contact access is not requested during sign-in.
settings.photosPermissionDetail: Photo references are supported, but Google Photos access is intentionally separate from sign-in.
settings.neutralDetail: This area is available in settings without any additional external connection.
settings.calendarPermissionDetail: Calendar reminders are planned, but calendar access is not requested during sign-in.
settings.notificationPermissionDetail: Reminder notifications will ask only when notification features are enabled.
settings.progressivePermissionsDetail: Keepl only uses Google sign-in right now. Contacts, Photos, Calendar, and notification permissions are kept behind their own future connection steps.
settings.photosLocalDisconnect: Disconnect clears Photos access in this Keepl session. It does not revoke Google permission or delete saved references. To revoke permission, use your Google Account settings. Reconnect after reloading Keepl.

graphPage.title: Relationship graph
graphPage.empty: Add relationships from a person profile to see them here.
graphPage.loadError: Could not load the relationship graph.

exportImportPage.exportDescription: Download a versioned JSON file containing only records owned by your signed-in Keepl account.
exportImportPage.importDescription: Choose a Keepl export file to validate it and preview what would be imported before anything is written.
exportImportPage.duplicatesHint: Possible duplicates were detected. You can skip whole collections before confirming the import.
exportImportPage.importError: Could not import the selected records.
exportImportPage.importValidationError: Invalid export: only version 1 with complete, valid records and unique IDs is supported. No records were written.
exportImportPage.restorePolicy: All selected records are restored as new copies with new IDs. Existing records are never overwritten or automatically matched. Select dependencies too. Imports commit in groups of up to 100; earlier groups remain after failure. Retry with the same file and selection to resume safely.
exportImportPage.candidate: Possible match - select to create a separate copy
exportImportPage.dependencies: Select the referenced records or deselect the dependent records before confirming:
exportImportPage.progress: {count} of {total} records committed or already restored.

personProfile.editDescription: Update what you keep close about {name}.

login.title: Remember the people and details that make life feel close.
login.description: Sign in with Google to keep your people, memories, dates, and notes in your own private Keepl space.
login.hint: Keepl starts with a gentle home for names, dates, notes, memories, and the relationships around them.
login.error: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Reconnect to view or edit your saved people, memories, dates, and reminders. Offline editing is not supported.

lifecycle.deletePolicy: Delete this person, their notes, dates, interactions, relationships, and related reminders. All memories are kept; only this person's references are removed. This cannot be undone. During cleanup, new references are blocked. If cleanup fails, review again to resume; earlier changes remain.
lifecycle.repairPolicy: Find records whose referenced people, groups, dates, or memories no longer exist. Review every proposed removal before confirming. Memories are preserved. Nothing is repaired automatically.
lifecycle.counts: Records to delete: {count}. Records to detach references from: {memories}.
lifecycle.error: Cleanup could not finish or the reviewed data changed. Earlier changes may remain. Review again before retrying. A pending deletion blocks edits and new references until it finishes.
lifecycle.loadError: Could not load records. Try again.
lifecycle.partialError: Some records could not be loaded. Incomplete results are hidden; try again.
lifecycle.mutationError: Could not finish saving changes. Try again; if a deletion is pending, finish it first.
lifecycle.pending: Deletion is pending. Review cleanup below to resume. Records already removed will not be removed twice.
lifecycle.archivePolicy: Archiving hides this person from active lists but keeps their profile, notes, dates, reminders, relationships, and memories. You can still open the profile by its link.
lifecycle.dateDelete: Delete {name} and its reminders? This cannot be undone.
lifecycle.memoryDelete: Delete {name} and its reminders? People and their other memories are kept.
